q: An architect publicly reviewing a colleague's completed building limits all remarks to constructive, professionally useful feedback rather than personal or destructive criticism, and does not claim the colleague's design ideas as their own. This conduct is called for by which Credo article?
o: Respect
Legacy
Professional Excellence
Ethical Relationship
Avisala
n: Respect pledges to respect the rights and works of colleagues and to "confine my comments to constructive intents." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Respect)

q: An architect, alone and unsupervised on site, quietly cuts a structural detail below what the approved plans specify, reasoning that no one else will ever know. Which article of the Architect's Credo most directly addresses the personal conscience that should stop this act even without outside scrutiny?
o: Respect
Sharing
Accountability
Legacy
n: Accountability pledges answerability to God, mother earth, country, fellowmen, and one's own self -- the personal, self-directed sense of answerability that should govern conduct even when no one is watching. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Accountability)

q: Who endorsed the proposed (updated) Architect's Credo to the Board and the Commission for consideration?
o: A private consortium of architecture schools
The Department of Public Works and Highways
The United Architects of the Philippines (UAP), as the Accredited and Integrated Professional Organization of Architects
The Professional Regulation Commission acting alone
n: The resolution states that the UAP, as the Accredited and Integrated Professional Organization of Architects, endorsed the proposed Architect's Credo through Board Resolution No. 99, s. of 2017-2018, for the Board and Commission's consideration. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause (UAP endorsement))

q: A newly licensed architect asks why, at their mass oath-taking ceremony, they are asked to recite a set of pledges aloud with the group. What is the basis, under the 2006 Code as referenced in this resolution, for this practice?
o: It is a purely social tradition with no basis in any Board issuance
It is required only for architects who join the UAP as officers
RA 9266 directly requires it as a licensing examination component
Article VII of the Code of Ethical Conduct enjoins architects to recite the Architect's Credo with vigor, passion and hope during such special occasions
n: The resolution recounts that Article VII of the Code of Ethical Conduct (adopted under Resolution No. 02, s. 2006) enjoins every registered and licensed architect to recite the Credo during special or important occasions such as mass oath taking. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause (Article VII of the Code))

q: According to the Professional Excellence article, industrious dedication and meaningful application to one's work should merit a reputation for what?
o: Quality of services worthy of fair remuneration
Volume of projects completed per year
Media recognition and public awards
Speed of project delivery above all else
n: The article states this dedication "merits a reputation for quality of services worthy of fair remuneration." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Professional Excellence)

q: When does Resolution No. 05, s. 2018 and its Annex take effect?
o: Immediately upon signing by the Board
Thirty (30) days after Senate ratification
After fifteen (15) days following its full and complete publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation
Upon the next UAP national convention
n: The resolution provides that it and its Annex "shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its full and complete publication in the Official Gazette or any daily newspaper of general circulation in the Philippines." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, effectivity clause)

q: What did Board Resolution No. 02, s. 2006 (the resolution being amended) originally adopt and promulgate?
o: The UAP's constitution and by-laws
The National Building Code of the Philippines
The Code of Ethical Conduct for Registered and Licensed Architects and Holders of Temporary/Special Permits under RA 9266
The first Architect's Credo
n: Resolution No. 02, s. 2006 adopted and promulgated the "Code of Ethical Conduct for Registered and Licensed Architects and for Holders of Temporary/Special Permits under RA No. 9266, known as the Architecture Act of 2004." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause 2 / title of Resolution No. 02, s. 2006)

q: An architect must balance the competing interests of a paying client, a subcontractor (industry partner), fellow professionals on the design team, and the surrounding community affected by a project. Maintaining the highest standard of professionalism toward all of these parties at once is the specific concern of which Credo article?
o: Legacy
Ethical Relationship
Respect
Norm of Conduct
n: Ethical Relationship specifically pledges the highest standard of professionalism "in relation to clients, colleagues, industry partners, and society" -- the full set of parties an architect must deal with fairly. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Ethical Relationship)

q: Under the resolution's Annex A, what is the given title of the compiled document containing the Credo?
o: The Uniform Building Bylaws
The National Building Code of the Philippines
The UAP Constitution and By-Laws
The Architect's Code of Ethics / The Architect's Credo
n: Annex A is headed "THE ARCHITECT'S CODE OF ETHICS" followed by "THE ARCHITECT'S CREDO," under which the seven articles and pledges are set out. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A heading)

q: According to the resolution, what does Article VII of the Code of Ethical Conduct enjoin every registered and licensed architect to do?
o: File an annual accomplishment report with the Board
Submit continuing professional development units to the UAP
Recite the Architect's Credo with vigor, passion and hope during special or important occasions
Renew their Professional Identification Card every three years
n: The resolution states that Article VII of the Code enjoins every registered and licensed architect to recite with vigor, passion and hope the Architect's Credo during special or important occasions. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause (Article VII of the Code))

q: Under "RESPECT," what does the architect pledge regarding colleagues in the profession?
o: To avoid all professional contact with competing architects
To publicly criticize competitors' designs without restriction
To respect the rights and works of colleagues and confine comments to constructive intents
To claim authorship over any design idea encountered
n: The Respect article reads: "I shall respect the rights and works of my colleagues in the profession and confine my comments to constructive intents." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Respect)

q: Under the article "ACCOUNTABILITY" in the Architect's Credo, to whom does the architect pledge to be accountable?
o: God, mother earth, my country, my fellowmen, and myself
Only the client and the Professional Regulation Commission
The Board of Architecture and the courts of law
Only fellow architects and the UAP
n: The Accountability article states: "I shall work with this general objective: that I am accountable to God, to mother earth, to my country, to my fellowmen, and to myself." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Accountability)

q: Why did the Board find it necessary to update the Architect's Credo in 2018?
o: RA 9266 required a mandatory five-year revision cycle
The UAP had disbanded and a new organization required a new Credo
The original Credo was found to be legally void
There was a need to update it to be attuned to the present times
n: The resolution states plainly, "there is a need to update the Architect's Credo to be attuned to the present times." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause)

q: An architect advises a client against demolishing a historically significant old structure and instead proposes adaptive reuse that also minimizes environmental impact for the benefit of future generations. This advice is most directly grounded in which Credo article?
o: Norm of Conduct
Legacy
Accountability
Sharing
n: Legacy pledges duty toward "protection of our common environment and the preservation of architectural heritage for the sake of the present and future generations" -- precisely the concern behind favoring adaptive reuse and environmental care. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Legacy)

q: Under "PROFESSIONAL EXCELLENCE," what level of integrity does the architect pledge to pursue moral and professional excellence toward?
o: A minimally acceptable level, sufficient to avoid sanction
A level set solely by client satisfaction surveys
An undefined, aspirational level with no standard
The utmost level of integrity
n: The Professional Excellence article pledges to "pursue moral and professional excellence to the utmost level of integrity through industrious dedication and meaningful application" to one's work. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Professional Excellence)

q: What did the Board ultimately resolve to do regarding the proposed Credo endorsed by the UAP?
o: Reject it and retain the original 2006 Code unchanged
Adopt it only on a provisional, non-binding basis
Refer it back to the UAP for further study without action
Support the ideals and principles embodied in it, and adopt and promulgate it as Annex A, amending Resolution No. 02, s. 2006
n: The Board resolved ("RESOLVES, as it is so RESOLVED") to adopt and promulgate the Architect's Credo as Annex A, amending Resolution No. 02, s. 2006 for the purpose, having expressed support for the ideals and principles in the UAP-endorsed proposal. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, resolving clause)

q: Professional Regulatory Board of Architecture (PRBA) Resolution No. 05, Series of 2018, primarily does what?
o: Adopts and promulgates the Architect's Credo, amending Board Resolution No. 02, s. 2006
Repeals RA 9266 in its entirety
Creates the Architecture Act of 2004
Establishes the licensure examination syllabus for architecture
n: Resolution No. 05, s. 2018 is titled "Adoption and Promulgation of the Architect's Credo, Amending for the Purpose Board Resolution No. 02, s. of 2006..." It updates, not repeals, the earlier resolution. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, title/resolving clause)

q: Under "ETHICAL RELATIONSHIP," to which groups does the architect pledge the highest standard of professionalism?
o: Shareholders and financiers of the project
Clients, colleagues, industry partners, and society
Only fellow licensed architects
Only clients and government regulators
n: The Ethical Relationship article reads: "I shall pledge myself to the highest standard of professionalism in relation to clients, colleagues, industry partners, and society." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Ethical Relationship)

q: Who is named in the resolution as Chairman approving Resolution No. 05, s. 2018?
o: Lovelika T. Bautista
Robert Wm. Mirafuente
Teofilo S. Pilando, Jr.
Jose Y. Cueto, Jr.
n: The document is signed as "APPROVED" by Teofilo S. Pilando, Jr., Chairman, with Commissioner Jose Y. Cueto, Jr. also signing as Commissioner. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, signature/approval block)

q: What is Republic Act No. 9266 also known as?
o: The Building Officials Act
The Code of Ethics for Architects
The Architecture Act of 2004
The Engineering Act of 2004
n: RA No. 9266 is expressly identified in the resolution as "The Architecture Act of 2004." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, title and WHEREAS clauses)

q: A senior architect mentors junior colleagues and openly shares an innovative sustainable design technique with peers rather than keeping it secret for competitive advantage. This behavior most directly embodies which article of the Credo?
o: Accountability
Sharing
Norm of Conduct
Respect
n: Sharing pledges the pursuit of creative endeavour toward the goal of enlightened Art and Science while "generously sharing it" -- exactly the mentorship and open dissemination described. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Sharing)

q: What closing invocation appears at the end of the Architect's Credo in Annex A?
o: "Adopted and promulgated, so ordered."
"In service to the profession."
"So help me God."
"For king and country."
n: The Credo's seven articles are followed immediately by the closing line "So help me God." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, closing line)

q: How does the resolution define the Architect's Credo?
o: A set of building design standards issued by the Board
A schedule of professional fees for architectural services
A binding contract between an architect and a client
A compendium of principles, beliefs and values that architects are expected to adhere to in their personal and professional dealings
n: The resolution states that the Architect's Credo "is a compendium of principles, beliefs and values that architects are expected to adhere to in the conduct of their personal and professional dealings." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause defining the Credo)

q: Under "LEGACY," what dual duty does the architect pledge to endeavour to perform?
o: Protection of our common environment and preservation of architectural heritage for present and future generations
Maximizing floor area ratio on every project regardless of context
Protection of client confidentiality after project completion
Preservation only of buildings the architect personally designed
n: The Legacy article reads: "I shall endeavour to do my duty in the protection of our common environment and the preservation of architectural heritage for the sake of the present and future generations." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Legacy)

q: What does the architect pledge under the "NORM OF CONDUCT" article of the Credo?
o: To prioritize profit over professional standards
To uphold the ideals and follow the norms and ethical conduct of the noble profession
To disclose trade secrets of competing firms
To follow only the client's instructions regardless of ethics
n: The Norm of Conduct article reads: "I shall uphold the ideals and follow the norms and ethical conduct of this noble profession." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Norm of Conduct)

q: Through what instrument did the UAP endorse its proposed Architect's Credo to the Board?
o: Republic Act No. 9266
Board Resolution No. 99, s. of 2017-2018
Board Resolution No. 02, s. of 2006
A private letter with no formal designation
n: The resolution states the UAP "endorsed through Board Resolution No. 99, s. of 2017-2018, its proposed Architect's Credo for the consideration of the Board and the Commission." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause (UAP endorsement))

q: What is the correct relationship between Board Resolution No. 02, s. 2006 and Board Resolution No. 05, s. 2018?
o: Resolution No. 05, s. 2018 repeals Resolution No. 02, s. 2006 in its entirety and replaces it wholesale
Resolution No. 05, s. 2018 amends Resolution No. 02, s. 2006 by adopting an updated Architect's Credo, while the rest of the 2006 Code of Ethical Conduct continues to stand
The two resolutions are unrelated and govern different professions
Resolution No. 02, s. 2006 was issued after, and supersedes, Resolution No. 05, s. 2018
n: Resolution No. 05, s. 2018 is explicitly an amendment "for the purpose" of updating the Credo within Resolution No. 02, s. 2006's Code of Ethical Conduct -- not a full repeal, and it postdates (not precedes) the 2006 resolution. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, title and resolving clause)

q: A licensed architect is offered a shortcut that would let a project be finished faster but at a visibly lower standard of workmanship than the architect's usual practice. Recommitting to industrious dedication and a reputation for quality work over expedience reflects which Credo article?
o: Accountability
Sharing
Ethical Relationship
Professional Excellence
n: Professional Excellence pledges pursuit of moral and professional excellence "to the utmost level of integrity through industrious dedication" that earns a reputation for quality of services. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Professional Excellence)

q: In what city, and on what date, was Resolution No. 05, s. 2018 done/signed?
o: Cebu City, on the 15th day of December, 2017
Quezon City, on the 1st day of January, 2018
Manila, on the 5th day of June, 2016
Manila, on the 4th day of June, 2018
n: The resolution's closing clause reads: "Done this 4th day of June, 2018 in the City of Manila." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, closing clause)

q: Under which law is the Professional Regulatory Board of Architecture mandated to monitor conditions affecting the practice of architecture and adopt measures for the enhancement and maintenance of high professional, ethical, and technical standards?
o: Republic Act No. 9266, the Architecture Act of 2004
Presidential Decree No. 1096, the National Building Code
Republic Act No. 9646, the Real Estate Service Act
Republic Act No. 1582
n: The resolution's first WHEREAS clause states that RA 9266 (The Architecture Act of 2004) mandates the Board to monitor conditions affecting the practice of architecture and adopt such measures as deemed proper for enhancing and maintaining high professional, ethical and technical standards. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause 1; RA 9266)

q: What does the architect pledge to dedicate themselves to under the "SHARING" article of the Credo?
o: The pursuit of creative endeavour toward enlightened Art and Science, generously sharing it
Withholding proprietary design methods from other architects
The pursuit of maximum personal profit from designs
Sharing only with clients who pay a premium fee
n: The Sharing article reads: "I shall dedicate myself to the pursuit of creative endeavour towards the goal of enlightened Art and Science, generously sharing it." (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A, Article: Sharing)

q: How many named articles (principles) make up the Architect's Credo as adopted in Annex A?
o: Ten
Seven
Five
Three
n: Annex A sets out seven named articles: Accountability, Norm of Conduct, Professional Excellence, Ethical Relationship, Sharing, Respect, and Legacy. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, Annex A)

q: Which of the following occasions does the resolution specifically cite as examples of when the Architect's Credo is recited?
o: Mass oath taking, UAP affairs, and Board events
Board licensure examinations only
Annual tax filing seminars
Client project turnovers only
n: The resolution names "mass oath taking, [UAP]'s affair and Board's events" as examples of special or important occasions for reciting the Credo. (Source: PRBA Resolution No. 05, s. 2018, WHEREAS clause (Article VII of the Code))
